title: An aerial shot shows damage to an industrial estate in southern China's Guangdong province after Typhoon Ragasa ripped through
text:
An aerial shot shows damage to an industrial estate in southern China's Guangdong province after Typhoon Ragasa ripped through
- ADEK BERRY
- Updated
0
As featured on
Hundreds of thousands of people in southern China were clearing up Thursday after powerful Typhoon Ragasa crashed through Guangdong Province, ripping down trees, destroying fences, and blasting signs off buildings.
